chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Ibrahim ibn Abi Bakr, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The fasting person should not smell the basil.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on smelling basil while fasting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking the act of smelling basil (*rihan*) to the state of fasting. While some jurists interpret this as a recommendation (*mustahabb*) to avoid scents that might stimulate appetite or thirst, others view it as a specific precaution against breaking the fast through excessive inhalation of potent aromas, reflecting the Shia emphasis on refining both physical and spiritual conduct during Ramadan.
